test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which among the following is a public sector bank?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bank of Baroda.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bank of Baroda **is a **public sector bank**, which means it is owned and operated by the** government of India.**
 
• **Axis Bank** and **ICICI Bank **are both **private sector banks,** which means they are owned and operated by **private individuals or organizations.**
 
• **Yes Bank** is also a **private sector bank,** but it is currently under the control of the **Reserve Bank of India **due to financial issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Public sector banks **are considered to be more** stable and secure** as they are backed by the **government,** while** private sector banks **may be more innovative and **customer-focused.**
 
• Some other examples of public sector banks in India include** State Bank of India, Punjab National Bank, and Bank of India.**
 
• Private sector banks in India include **HDFC Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, and IndusInd Bank. **
 
• It is important to note that all banks in India are regulated by the** Reserve Bank of India**, which is the central bank of the country.
